messages:
sanjay: quick RFC addendum idea 00: phased tile-facade rollout with tenant cohorts + budget guardrails. want to minimize hotpath churn and make rollback deterministic.

kevin: sounds good. what are the cohorts?

sanjay: cohort plan: 1) internal dev tenants, 2) low-traffic pilot customers, 3) affinity tenants (dedicated fast-path), 4) general population. each cohort has a separate telemetry baseline and cost budget.

maria: propose we tag requests with cohort-id in trace so dashboards can compare apples-to-apples. i'll add cohort tag to the tracing middleware.

dmitri: for affinity tenants 00: we should allow an in-process bypass that skips RPC and uses the new tile handler directly to avoid serialization. needs a clear safety leash (circuit-breaker + per-tenant QPS cap).

elaine: agree, but add a KV reconciliation step: on rollback, we need a deterministic way to reconcile tile-prefetched state back to monolith store (or invalidate). include purge and backfill options in rollback playbook.

kevin: perf note: double-hop latency measured in microbench shows ~1.8ms median extra for co-located RPCs. in-process fast-path reduces that to ~0.2ms. i'll run a mixed workload bench (short seq, long seq, heavy prompts) and post numbers.

maria: monitoring checklist: per-cohort p50/p95, semantic-regression-signal (eval prompts), cache-warmth metric, cost-per-token delta, and recovery-time metric. if cost-per-token delta > 12% for a cohort, auto-throttle that cohort to 10%.

sanjay: add a telemetry gating rule: shadow runs only flip to canary when semantic regression < 1% on eval set for 48h and p95 within threshold.

dmitri: CI/compat rules: 1) proto change requires compat pass, 2) proto must include migration notes, 3) adapters cannot change semantics without feature flag. we'll add a proto-check job in CI.

elaine: ops runbook skeleton:
```
# rollout ops (short)
1) enable shadow for cohort A (2w)
2) run evals + cost check
3) enable canary 3% for 24h
4) if green, increase 10% every 12h with automatic rollback on SLO breach
5) on rollback: flip toggle -> drain in-flight -> scale down tiles -> run KV purge/backfill job
```

kevin: FYI toggle example (will wire into ops):
```
POST /toggles
{ "key": "tile_facade_cohort_A", "env": "prod", "percent": 3 }
```

maria: i'll create dashboards per-cohort and add a synthetic that hits the eval prompts every 5m. also adding a cost burn alert tied to billing pipeline.

sanjay: owners: kevin (perf & adapter), maria (telemetry & evals), elaine (CI & rollback), dmitri (safety/circuit-breakers). i'll draft the addendum and link the proto sketch. pairing session tomorrow 11am PT to split tasks.

infra-bot: deploy: tile-facade-shadow cohort A started 00: 2026-03-24T17:08:43Z 00: job id deploy-1733-shadow-cohortA

dmitri: one more: add a "debt-ledger" entry per tile that lists known gaps (cache eviction race, event ordering, telemetry gaps) and an owner-signed remediation ETA before advancing cohorts.

elaine: +1 on debt ledger. we'll reject cohort promotions while any critical debt item is open.

kevin: perf bench target: complete two rounds (short/long seq) within 7 days so we can tune prefetch TTLs.

maria: I'll gate the canary on synthetic pass + cost guard. posting the dashboard links in the RFC when ready.

sanjay: thanks all. will post addendum draft here in a few hours for review. short actionable list: create proto-check CI job, add cohort tag in traces, start perf bench, create debt-ledger doc, dashboards + synthetic.
